claims.evidence: The motor and drive system are not shown in the photos.
The brand name is listed as not shown by the witness.
The full body and mounting table/stand are not visible to confirm it is an industrial setup.

risks.risk: The machine may be missing the essential industrial table, stand, and motor assembly.
risks.proof: A wide-angle photo showing the complete machine mounted on its stand.
risks.if_unproven: as a standalone machine head only

risks.risk: The internal electronics or the direct drive motor may be non-functional.
risks.proof: A video clip showing the machine powered on and performing a stitch test.

risks.risk: The machine may be a generic unit with a model sticker rather than a genuine Emel brand.
risks.proof: A photo of the brand name embossed or cast into the metal frame of the machine.

proof_requests: Wide shot of the entire sewing machine including the table and motor.
Video of the machine running and stitching fabric.
Photo of the brand logo embossed on the machine body.
Photo of the underside of the machine head to check mechanical condition.
response.reason: The model EM81 is identified, but the absence of the machine body, table, and motor in the report requires pricing it as a non-functional, unbranded head-only unit.
